summary: Netconf plugins moved to Galaxy collections and are included in pip installs of 2.10+. List them with ansible-doc -t netconf -l.
questions: How do I list netconf plugins?
Where are netconf plugins in recent Ansible releases?

answer_card.title: Listing netconf plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
They now live in collections on Galaxy, included in pip installs of 2.10+.

```shell
ansible-doc -t netconf -l
ansible-doc -t netconf <plugin name>
```
